facts.business: Shardul Securities Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) Systemically Important Non-Deposit taking, engaged in investment activities including quoted and unquoted equity shares, bullion, AIFs, and mutual funds.
key_risks: Geopolitical tensions and military conflicts disrupting global trade and energy markets
Volatility in crude oil prices impacting Indian economy and inflation
Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) withdrawals causing capital market volatility
Rupee depreciation and foreign exchange reserve depletion
High valuations and slower corporate earnings growth
Valuation uncertainty of unquoted investments involving significant estimation and judgment
Dependence on IT systems for financial accounting and reporting processes
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties were in ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. Details of material RPTs reported in Form AOC-2 (Annexure 3). Prior Audit Committee approval obtained including omnibus approval for repetitive transactions. Policy available at http://www.shardulsecurities.com/related%20party%20transaction%20policy.pdf.
